chunks.arabic_text: العيون: بالأسانيد الثلاثة عن الرضا عن آبائه عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله قال

translations.en: Al-Ayun: Via the three chains from al-Ridha from his forefathers from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) who said:

chunks.arabic_text: مَنْ حَسُنَ فِقْهُهُ فَ لَهُ حَسَنَةٌ

translations.en: Whosoever's understanding (fiqh) is good, then for him is a good deed (or reward).

en.summary: This hadith emphasizes the virtue of deep religious understanding (fiqh). It states that possessing good fiqh is itself considered a 'hasanah' (a good deed or reward), highlighting the high status of knowledge and comprehension in Shia tradition.
en.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for having good religious understanding (fiqh)?

key_terms.فِقْهُ: Understanding, comprehension, or jurisprudence; in this context, it refers to deep religious insight rather than just legal rulings.
key_terms.حَسَنَةٌ: A good deed, virtue, or reward; here it signifies that the state of having good fiqh is itself counted as a meritorious act.
